results.question: 各客户等级分别有多少客户?
results.sql:
SELECT dim_public.describe AS 客户等级, COUNT(ads_cust_info_d.pty_id) AS 客户数量
FROM ads_cust_info_d
JOIN dim_public ON ads_cust_info_d.cust_lvl_cd = dim_public.code AND dim_public.code_type_id = '100'
WHERE ads_cust_info_d.data_dt = '20260531'
GROUP BY dim_public.describe
ORDER BY 客户数量 DESC

results.question: 男性、女性客户各有多少人?
results.sql: SELECT dim_public.describe AS 性别, COUNT(ads_cust_info_d.pty_id) AS 客户人数 FROM ads_cust_info_d JOIN dim_public ON ads_cust_info_d.gender_cd = dim_public.code AND dim_public.code_type_id = '500' WHERE ads_cust_info_d.data_dt = '20260531' GROUP BY dim_public.describe ORDER BY 客户人数 DESC

results.question: 各学历客户分别有多少人?
results.sql: SELECT dim_public.describe AS 学历, COUNT(ads_cust_info_d.pty_id) AS 客户人数 FROM ads_cust_info_d JOIN dim_public ON ads_cust_info_d.edu_cd = dim_public.code AND dim_public.code_type_id = '600' WHERE ads_cust_info_d.data_dt = '20260531' GROUP BY dim_public.describe ORDER BY 客户人数 DESC

results.question: 各职业客户分别有多少人(前 10)?
results.sql:
SELECT dim_public.describe AS 职业, COUNT(ads_cust_info_d.pty_id) AS 客户人数
FROM ads_cust_info_d
JOIN dim_public ON ads_cust_info_d.prof_cd = dim_public.code AND dim_public.code_type_id = '700'
WHERE ads_cust_info_d.data_dt = '20260531'
GROUP BY dim_public.describe
ORDER BY 客户人数 DESC
LIMIT 10

results.question: 按年龄段(30 岁以下/30-50/50-60/60 以上)客户分别有多少人?
results.sql:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN cust_age < 30 THEN '30岁以下'
    WHEN cust_age < 40 THEN '30-39岁'
    WHEN cust_age < 50 THEN '40-49岁'
    WHEN cust_age < 60 THEN '50-59岁'
    ELSE '60岁及以上'
  END AS 年龄段,
  COUNT(pty_id) AS 客户人数
FROM ads_cust_info_d
WHERE data_dt = '20260531'
GROUP BY 年龄段
ORDER BY 年龄段 ASC

results.question: 硕士及以上学历的女性客户有多少人?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.pty_id) AS 客户人数
FROM ads_cust_info_d a
JOIN dim_public e ON a.edu_cd = e.code AND e.code_type_id = '600'
JOIN dim_public g ON a.gender_cd = g.code AND g.code_type_id = '500'
WHERE a.data_dt = '20260531'
  AND e.describe IN ('硕士', '博士')
  AND g.describe = '女'

results.question: 各分公司下分别有多少营业部?
results.sql: SELECT up_org_name AS 分公司, COUNT(org_id) AS 营业部数量 FROM dim_branch GROUP BY up_org_name ORDER BY 营业部数量 DESC

results.question: 2026 年一季度各产品一级分类的买入金额分别是多少?
results.sql: SELECT dim_product.up_prdt_type_id AS 产品一级分类, SUM(dwd_cust_tran_d.buy_amt) AS 买入金额 FROM dwd_cust_tran_d JOIN dim_product ON dwd_cust_tran_d.prdt_id = dim_product.prdt_id WHERE dwd_cust_tran_d.data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331' GROUP BY dim_product.up_prdt_type_id ORDER BY 买入金额 DESC

results.question: 各分公司分别有多少客户?

results.question: 2026 年一季度普通账户和信用账户的交易金额分别是多少?
results.sql: SELECT sys_source AS 账户类型, SUM(buy_amt) + SUM(sell_amt) AS 交易金额 FROM dwd_cust_tran_d WHERE data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331' AND sys_source IN ('nm', 'fc') GROUP BY sys_source ORDER BY 账户类型

results.question: 2026-03-31 各客户等级客户的总资产分别是多少?
results.sql:
SELECT 
  dp.describe AS 客户等级,
  SUM(dad.nm_tot_aset + dad.fc_pur_aset) AS 总资产
FROM ads_cust_info_d aci
JOIN dws_cust_aset_d dad 
  ON aci.pty_id = dad.pty_id 
  AND aci.data_dt = dad.data_dt
JOIN dim_public dp 
  ON aci.cust_lvl_cd = dp.code 
  AND dp.code_type_id = '100'
WHERE dad.data_dt = '20260331'
GROUP BY dp.describe
ORDER BY 总资产 DESC

results.question: 2026 年一季度交易额(买入+卖出)前 10 的客户是哪些?
results.sql:
SELECT 
    t.pty_id AS 客户ID,
    c.name AS 客户姓名,
    SUM(t.buy_amt + t.sell_amt) AS 交易额
FROM dwd_cust_tran_d t
JOIN ads_cust_info_d c ON t.pty_id = c.pty_id
WHERE t.data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331'
GROUP BY t.pty_id, c.name
ORDER BY 交易额 DESC
LIMIT 10

results.question: 2026 年一季度交易过招商银行相关产品的客户有多少人?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.pty_id) AS 客户人数
FROM dwd_cust_tran_d t
JOIN dim_product p ON t.prdt_id = p.prdt_id
WHERE t.data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331'
  AND p.prdt_name LIKE '%招商银行%'

results.question: 2026-03-31 持仓市值最高的 10 个产品二级分类是哪些?
results.sql:
SELECT dp.prdt_type_name AS 产品二级分类, SUM(dh.mkt_val) AS 持仓市值
FROM dwd_cust_hold_d dh
JOIN dim_product dp ON dh.prdt_id = dp.prdt_id
WHERE dh.data_dt = '20260331'
GROUP BY dp.prdt_type_name
ORDER BY 持仓市值 DESC
LIMIT 10
